output:
usage: paf [-h]
           {doctor,pixelate,scale,palette,recolor,source,export,cursor,background,theme,provider}
           ...

paf — the local pixel art factory.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,pixelate,scale,palette,recolor,source,export,cursor,background,theme,provider}
    doctor              report available tools and providers
    pixelate            downscale + quantize into pixel art
    scale               integer nearest-neighbor upscale
    palette             extract a .gpl palette
    recolor             remap an image onto a .gpl palette
    source              PNG -> editable .aseprite
    export              .aseprite -> PNG
    cursor              package a PNG as a cursor theme
    background          pixel art -> wallpaper canvas
    theme               scaffold an Omarchy theme
    provider            OPTIONAL: generate via the PixelLab API

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
usage: paf pixelate [-h] --width WIDTH [--colors COLORS] input output

positional arguments:
  input
  output

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --width WIDTH    target pixel-art width (height keeps aspect)
  --colors COLORS  quantize to N colors (0 = keep RGB)
usage: paf recolor [-h] --palette PALETTE [--dither {none,ordered}]
                   input output

positional arguments:
  input
  output

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --palette PALETTE
  --dither {none,ordered}
usage: paf provider [-h] [--size SIZE] prompt output

positional arguments:
  prompt
  output

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --size SIZE
